# Security policy

## Supported versions

| Version | Security updates |
| --- | --- |
| 2.x | Supported |
| 1.x and older | Not supported |

## Reporting a vulnerability

Use [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/user01010111/ha-contact-energy/security/advisories/new) for vulnerabilities in this integration or its release pipeline. Do not open a public issue before a coordinated fix is available.

Never include Contact Energy credentials, session values, cookies, request headers, ICPs, account or contract identifiers, physical addresses, complete usage URLs, or raw API bodies. Use synthetic placeholders and the smallest reproduction necessary.

The maintainer aims to acknowledge a report within seven days and provide a status update at least every fourteen days while it remains open. Timing for a fix depends on impact, reproducibility, and upstream dependencies. Please allow a reasonable coordinated-disclosure period after a fix is available.

Contact Energy's service and Home Assistant Core are third-party systems. Report defects in those systems to their respective owners unless this integration or its release process creates the vulnerability.
